IncidentDef.label: Wraith Hive retaliation
IncidentDef.letterText: Surviving Wraith forces have regrouped after the destruction of a mature Hive and are striking back at your colony.

IncidentDef.label: Wraith anti-Asuran extermination strike
IncidentDef.letterText: The hostile Wraith Brood has identified synthetic nanite humanoids in your colony as an existential replication threat and committed combat forces to destroy them.
